why: Pass priority. Casting Brute Force (1R) to pump Kird Ape from 1/1 to 2/3 is ineffective—next turn, if opponent's 3/3 Courser attacks and I block, my 2/3 Ape still dies to 3 damage (same outcome as unpumped). I'm not attacking this turn, so the pump adds no offense. I need to preserve resources and mana flexibility. Current board (4 Mountains untapped) is insufficient for Bonebreaker Giant (needs 6 total). Advancing to next turn via pass gets me closer to the 5-land state (need 1 more play) and eventual Bonebreaker deployment on turn 9 to stabilize the race.
